milestones.title: M0: Foundation
milestones.description: Monorepo, launcher, authentication, tenancy, audit, roles, seed and engineering documentation.

milestones.title: M1: Facilities and assets
milestones.description: Facility registry and hierarchy, site access, asset registry, attachments and CSV import (FR-01, FR-02).

milestones.title: M2: Work orders and SLA
milestones.description: Work-order lifecycle, assignment, technician execution, checklists, labor and the SLA engine (FR-03, FR-04, FR-05).

milestones.title: M3: Preventive maintenance, inventory and approvals
milestones.description: Background worker, PM generation, stock ledger, part requests and repair approvals (FR-06, FR-07, FR-08).

milestones.title: M4: Insights, notifications and administration
milestones.description: Cost model, dashboard, reports, notifications, audit viewer and organization settings (FR-09, FR-10).

milestones.title: M5: Acceptance and hardening
milestones.description: Playwright acceptance suite for PRD §9, security review, accessibility and polish.

tickets.title: Set up monorepo, launcher and CI
tickets.description: Create the npm-workspaces monorepo (api, web, shared), the single run.sh launcher and the GitHub Actions pipeline. A fresh clone must reach a running app with one command.
acceptanceCriteria: ./run.sh on a fresh clone installs, migrates, seeds and launches API and web
CI runs lint, format check, typecheck, tests with coverage and build
gitleaks secret scan runs on every push

tickets.title: Implement session authentication with CSRF and rate limiting
tickets.description: Local email/password sign-in with scrypt hashes, server-side sessions in PostgreSQL, HTTP-only SameSite cookies, origin checks plus HMAC CSRF tokens, and rate limiting on login.
acceptanceCriteria: Passwords are hashed with scrypt and a unique salt
Session tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes
Unsafe requests without a valid CSRF token are rejected with 403
Login failures return one generic message

tickets.title: Provide migration runner, audit trail and health checks
tickets.description: Forward-only SQL migrations with checksums, an append-only audit_events table written in the same transaction as business changes, and liveness/readiness endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing an applied migration aborts startup
Readiness returns 503 when PostgreSQL is unreachable
Audit writer accepts a transaction client

tickets.title: Introduce AssetOps roles and permission matrix
tickets.description: Replace the placeholder roles with Organization Admin, Facility Manager, Technician and Requester; add a shared permission matrix used by API guards and the UI; constrain users.role in migration 0002.
acceptanceCriteria: users.role rejects values outside the four PRD roles
requirePermission guards return 403 for roles without the permission
Navigation visibility is derived from the same role lists

tickets.title: Seed development organizations, users and facilities
tickets.description: Idempotent development-only seed with Riverside Hospitality and Northline Fitness, one demo user per role in the primary organization, an admin in the secondary organization and two facilities each.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed refuses to run when NODE_ENV=production
Re-running the seed does not duplicate rows
Every demo login is documented in README

tickets.title: Write engineering documentation, ADRs and API contract
tickets.description: Architecture overview, system design, data model, OpenAPI 3.1 contract, threat model, test strategy, runbook, roadmap, backlog and ADRs 0001-0017.
acceptanceCriteria: Every PRD §7 endpoint appears in openapi.yaml with x-status and x-ticket
Every FR and acceptance test maps to at least one ticket
backlog.json and backlog.md list the same tickets

tickets.title: Support multi-organization memberships and active-organization resolution
tickets.description: Introduce the memberships table so one user can belong to several organizations, store the active organization on the session and resolve it on every request. Replaces the single users.organization_id link.
acceptanceCriteria: A user with two memberships can switch organization via POST /organizations/switch
Switching to an organization without an active membership returns 403
All existing tenant queries keep using the session organization
Membership changes are audited

tickets.title: Build organization and site switcher
tickets.description: Top-bar switcher listing the user's active memberships and granted sites; switching reloads tenant-scoped data.
acceptanceCriteria: Only organizations with an active membership are listed
Switching organization clears cached tenant data
Site filter persists for the session

tickets.title: Load the full PRD §8 demonstration dataset
tickets.description: Extend the seed with areas, 120 assets, 6 technicians, 45 work orders across statuses, 15 parts, 5 schedules, breached SLAs and the named scenarios (AC breakdown, generator service today, pump repair awaiting approval, low-stock filter, overdue order).
acceptanceCriteria: Riverside has 2 properties with 3 areas each and 120 assets
Each named scenario is reachable from the UI after ./run.sh reset --yes
Northline data is fully independent

tickets.title: Build facilities list, create and get API
tickets.description: Tenant-scoped facilities CRUD slice: zod schemas, repository, service and routes with pagination, search, role gate for creation, unique per-organization codes and an audit event in the same transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /facilities returns only the caller's organization with page metadata
POST /facilities is 403 for technicians and requesters
Duplicate code in the same organization returns 409
Another organization's facility id returns 404

tickets.title: Build facilities list and create screen
tickets.description: Facilities screen with server-side pagination and search, loading/empty/error states, and a validated create form shown only to roles with facility:create.
acceptanceCriteria: List renders data from the API with pagination controls
Create form validates with the shared schema before submitting
Technicians and requesters do not see the create form

tickets.title: Update and archive facilities with reference guard
tickets.description: PATCH /facilities/:id with optimistic locking via version, soft-delete through archived_at, and a guard that blocks archiving while active assets or open work orders reference the facility.
acceptanceCriteria: Stale version returns 409
Archiving a facility with active assets returns 409 with a reason
Updates and archives write before/after audit events

tickets.title: Manage the site-building-area hierarchy
tickets.description: Areas table with parent_area_id up to three levels, API under /facilities/:id/areas and a tree editor on the facilities screen.
acceptanceCriteria: A fourth nesting level is rejected with 422
Areas cannot reference a facility of another organization
Tree editor supports add, rename and archive

tickets.title: Restrict non-admin users to granted sites
tickets.description: Site-access grants per membership; all facility, asset and work-order queries for non-admins are filtered to granted sites while org admins see every site.
acceptanceCriteria: A manager without a grant gets 404 for that site's records
Org admins see all sites without grants
Grant changes are audited

tickets.title: Implement asset registry API
tickets.description: Assets table and list/create/get/patch endpoints with organization-scoped unique codes, money in minor units, search by code/name/serial and filters by site, criticality and status.
acceptanceCriteria: Asset codes are unique per organization
purchase cost is stored as integer minor units
Cross-organization asset ids return 404 (A-02)
Filters and pagination run server-side

tickets.title: Build searchable assets table
tickets.description: Assets table with server-side search, site/criticality/status filters, pagination and an entry point to CSV import.
acceptanceCriteria: Filters are reflected in the URL
Empty and loading states are shown
Requesters cannot reach the screen

tickets.title: Build asset create and edit form
tickets.description: Form for asset details including site/area, warranty expiry, criticality and purchase cost entered in major units and sent as minor units.
acceptanceCriteria: Validation messages come from the shared schema
Cost input converts to integer minor units
Optimistic-lock conflicts show a reload prompt

tickets.title: Build asset detail with history and cost
tickets.description: Asset detail page with lifecycle timeline, maintenance history, attachments, repair count, recorded maintenance cost and last service date derived from authoritative records.
acceptanceCriteria: Repair count and cost are computed from work orders and ledger rows, not stored counters
Completed work orders appear in history after closure (A-11)

tickets.title: Import assets from CSV with preview
tickets.description: Two-step CSV import: preview with row-by-row validation (including duplicates in file and in database) and an all-or-nothing commit keyed by asset code for safe re-import.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview lists every invalid or duplicate row with a reason
Commit runs in one transaction; any error leaves data unchanged (A-12)
Re-importing the same file updates rather than duplicates

tickets.title: Store attachments safely on local disk
tickets.description: Multipart upload with MIME allowlist verified by magic bytes, size limit, generated filenames, path traversal protection and tenant-checked download.
acceptanceCriteria: Executables and oversized files are rejected with 422 (A-14)
Stored filenames are random and never derived from user input
Downloads verify organization ownership

tickets.title: Implement work-order state machine domain
tickets.description: Pure, immutable state machine for the PRD lifecycle with per-role guards, assignee rules, required-checklist and resolution gates, approval gate, no self-approval on closure and locking of closed orders.
acceptanceCriteria: Every edge outside the lifecycle returns INVALID_TRANSITION
Completion with an open required checklist item returns CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE (A-05)
Resuming from AWAITING_APPROVAL without a decision returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED (A-08)
The assignee cannot close their own work
100% branch coverage

tickets.title: Implement SLA calculator domain
tickets.description: Pure SLA functions: site-over-default policy resolution, elapsed-clock due dates, response/resolution evaluation (pending, at risk, met, breached) and deduplicated escalation keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Response stops at the first accepted technician action, not assignment
Resolution stops at COMPLETED
At-risk triggers at 80% of budget; breach strictly after due time
Escalations already sent are not re-emitted (A-10)
100% branch coverage

tickets.title: Create, list and read work orders
tickets.description: Work orders table with per-organization sequential codes, creation that computes SLA due dates from policy, list with status/priority/assignee/SLA filters and record-level visibility (requesters see their own).
acceptanceCriteria: Created orders get a unique code like WO-000123 (A-03)
Requesters only see orders they requested
Cross-organization ids return 404
response_due_at and resolve_due_at are stored in UTC

tickets.title: Expose transition endpoint with optimistic locking
tickets.description: POST /work-orders/:id/transition loads the order and checklist, applies the domain state machine, persists with a version check and writes work_order_events plus audit in one transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Domain errors map to 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION or 403 with the domain code
Concurrent transitions with the same version: exactly one succeeds
Event and audit rows commit atomically with the status change

tickets.title: Assign and reassign technicians
tickets.description: Assignment endpoint that validates the assignee is an active technician in the same organization, records assigned time and keeps reassignment history.
acceptanceCriteria: Assigning a user from another organization returns 422
Reassignment history is preserved as events
Assignee receives an in-app notification (A-04)

tickets.title: Complete checklist items
tickets.description: Checklist items snapshot on the order; assignee or manager can complete an item; completion is blocked once the order is closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Completing an item records completed_by and completed_at
Items on CLOSED orders cannot change (ORDER_LOCKED)

tickets.title: Record immutable labor entries with corrections
tickets.description: Labor entries with signed minutes and a captured hourly-rate snapshot; corrections are new negative/positive entries, never updates.
acceptanceCriteria: There is no UPDATE path for labor entries
Corrections reference the original entry
Labor on closed orders is rejected

tickets.title: Build work orders board
tickets.description: Board/table of work orders with status, priority, assignee and SLA badge filters, all server-side.
acceptanceCriteria: SLA badges use the server-computed state
Filters and pagination are server-side

tickets.title: Build work-order request form
tickets.description: Request form with site, optional asset, fault description, priority and photo attachments; optimized to finish in under two minutes.
acceptanceCriteria: Requester can submit a broken-AC report and see its code after reload (A-03)
Photo uploads show progress and validation errors

tickets.title: Build work-order detail view
tickets.description: Detail page with timeline, assignment, checklist, labor, parts, approvals and transition buttons driven by allowed targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Only transitions allowed for the current status are offered
Domain errors are shown as actionable messages
Printer-friendly variant available (FR-09)

tickets.title: Build technician My Work queue
tickets.description: Narrow-screen queue of the technician's assigned work sorted by priority and SLA urgency with status and facility filters.
acceptanceCriteria: Sorted by priority then SLA remaining time
Usable at 360px width

tickets.title: Create follow-up orders and capture cancellation reasons
tickets.description: Reopening a closed order creates a new linked order (parent_order_id) instead of mutating history; cancellation stores the reason.
acceptanceCriteria: Follow-up order references the original
Original closed order is unchanged

tickets.title: Configure SLA policies and overdue queue
tickets.description: SLA policy table per priority with optional site override, API to read/replace policies and a screen with the overdue queue and the elapsed-clock policy explained.
acceptanceCriteria: Policies validate resolution >= response
Site-specific overrides take precedence
Overdue queue lists breached orders server-side

tickets.title: Escalate SLA risk and breaches from the worker
tickets.description: Worker tick evaluates open orders, emits at-risk (80%) and breach notifications using dedupe keys with a unique constraint.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the tick twice creates no duplicate alerts (A-10)
Breached orders show a breached badge

tickets.title: Configure closure verification policy
tickets.description: Organization setting selecting manager verification or requester acceptance for closure, passed to the state machine context.
acceptanceCriteria: Policy change is audited
Closure obeys the configured policy

tickets.title: Add background worker tick infrastructure
tickets.description: In-process interval worker with advisory-lock leader election, structured logs and a manual trigger for development.
acceptanceCriteria: Only one tick runs at a time across processes
Tick failures are logged and do not crash the API

tickets.title: Manage maintenance templates
tickets.description: Templates with category or asset target, checklist items, expected minutes, default priority and versioning.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing a template bumps its version and affects future work only

tickets.title: Manage schedules and recurrence calculation
tickets.description: Daily/weekly/monthly schedules in the facility's local time zone with a pure next-occurrence function covering month-end and DST edges.
acceptanceCriteria: Monthly on the 31st falls back to the last day of shorter months
Next due date is computed in the schedule time zone
Unit tests cover recurrence edges

tickets.title: Generate due preventive work idempotently
tickets.description: Worker and POST /maintenance/run-due create one order per (schedule_id, occurrence_date) using INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, snapshot the checklist and advance next_local_date.
acceptanceCriteria: Triggering generation twice yields exactly one order per occurrence (A-09)
Generated orders keep checklist snapshots after template edits

tickets.title: Build preventive maintenance and calendar screens
tickets.description: Template and schedule management plus a calendar of future occurrences and overdue scheduled work.
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar shows future occurrences without creating them
Overdue scheduled work is highlighted

tickets.title: Manage parts catalogue and balances
tickets.description: Parts with organization-unique SKU, unit, reorder point and unit cost in minor units; per-facility balances.
acceptanceCriteria: SKU unique per organization
Technicians receive parts without unit cost fields

tickets.title: Record stock movements in an append-only ledger
tickets.description: RECEIPT/ISSUE/RETURN/ADJUSTMENT movements with a balance update in the same transaction using a conditional update that never allows negative stock.
acceptanceCriteria: Issuing 2 of 3 leaves 1 and records an ISSUE row (A-06)
Concurrent over-issue: exactly one succeeds, stock never negative (A-07)
Ledger rows are never updated or deleted

tickets.title: Request and issue parts for work orders
tickets.description: Technician part requests, manager approval where required, and stock consumption only on issue linked to the work order.
acceptanceCriteria: Requesting a part does not change stock
Issuing consumes stock and captures unit cost snapshot

tickets.title: Build inventory and ledger screens
tickets.description: Parts list with per-site balances, ledger history and a low-stock view; pricing hidden for technicians.
acceptanceCriteria: Low-stock filter lists parts at or below reorder point
Technicians never see unit cost

tickets.title: Implement repair approval policy domain
tickets.description: Pure functions deciding whether an estimate needs approval (amount_minor > organization threshold), forbidding self-approval and duplicate active approvals per decision context.
acceptanceCriteria: Estimates above threshold require approval; equal-to-threshold does not
Requester cannot approve own request
Second active request for the same context is rejected

tickets.title: Build approvals API
tickets.description: Approval requests from work orders, inbox listing and decide endpoint with partial unique index for one active request per context; decisions notify and audit.
acceptanceCriteria: Work stays blocked until an authorized decision (A-08)
Rejected requests remain visible and audited
Deciding twice returns 409

tickets.title: Build approval inbox
tickets.description: Inbox and request detail with estimate, justification, history and approve/reject with comment.
acceptanceCriteria: Approver cannot act on their own requests (button hidden and API rejects)

tickets.title: Implement work-order cost computation
tickets.description: Pure cost function: labor_minutes x hourly rate / 60 + sum(issued qty x captured unit cost) in integer minor units with explicit incomplete flags for missing rates.
acceptanceCriteria: Rounding is half-up to the minor unit
Missing rates produce an 'incomplete' flag, never zero
Unit tests cover mixed labor and parts

tickets.title: Build operations report and CSV export API
tickets.description: Aggregations for cards and charts with date/site filters and a CSV export that applies the same filters and authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: Export rows equal the filtered report rows (A-15)
CSV cells are escaped against formula injection

tickets.title: Build operations dashboard
tickets.description: Dashboard cards for open, overdue, completed this month, low stock and response SLA compliance plus recent activity.
acceptanceCriteria: All values come from the API; no hard-coded KPIs
Completing and closing an order updates the cards (A-11)

tickets.title: Build reports screen with charts
tickets.description: Charts for orders by priority/status/site, spend trend, most repaired assets and labor by technician, with filters and CSV export.
acceptanceCriteria: Charts render without external CDNs
Incomplete cost data is labelled as estimate

tickets.title: Build notifications API
tickets.description: Persistent in-app notifications with unread count and mark-as-read, scoped to the signed-in user and organization.
acceptanceCriteria: Notifications survive server restart (A-13)
Users cannot read others' notifications (404)

tickets.title: Build notifications center
tickets.description: Notification list with unread badge in the top bar and mark-as-read.
acceptanceCriteria: Unread badge updates after marking as read

tickets.title: Build audit log API and viewer
tickets.description: Read-only, filterable audit log for admins and managers with no edit or delete paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Technicians and requesters receive 403
No API route modifies audit events

tickets.title: Build users, roles and organization settings
tickets.description: Org admins manage users and roles, approval threshold, closure policy, labor rate and currency; managers cannot change security settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Facility managers receive 403 on settings endpoints
Role changes are audited
Approval threshold stored in minor units

tickets.title: Automate role and tenant isolation acceptance tests
tickets.description: Playwright specs signing in as all four roles, probing cross-organization ids and verifying persistence after reload and API restart.
acceptanceCriteria: A-01, A-02 and A-13 pass against the real database
Specs are repeatable after ./run.sh reset --yes

tickets.title: Automate work-order lifecycle acceptance tests
tickets.description: Playwright specs covering request creation, assignment, checklist gate and completion through closure with dashboard updates.
acceptanceCriteria: A-03, A-04, A-05 and A-11 pass

tickets.title: Automate inventory, approval, PM and SLA acceptance tests
tickets.description: Playwright and API-level specs for stock issue, concurrent over-issue, approval blocking, idempotent generation and SLA alerts.
acceptanceCriteria: A-06 through A-10 pass
Concurrency test issues parallel requests

tickets.title: Automate import, upload and export acceptance tests
tickets.description: Specs for CSV preview with bad rows, rejected executable/oversized uploads and filtered CSV export parity.
acceptanceCriteria: A-12, A-14 and A-15 pass

tickets.title: Run security hardening review
tickets.description: ASVS L2 checklist review, dependency audit, CSP for the web build and verification that every route has authentication and object-level checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Threat model mitigations updated to implemented
No high or critical npm audit findings

tickets.title: Polish accessibility, responsiveness and states
tickets.description: WCAG 2.1 AA pass, keyboard navigation, focus management in dialogs, skeletons, empty states and confirmation dialogs.
acceptanceCriteria: axe scan reports no serious violations on core screens
Critical flows work at 360px width

tickets.title: Add demo-account selector to sign-in
tickets.description: Development-only selector that fills a demo identity on the login page; absent in production builds.
acceptanceCriteria: Selector hidden when NODE_ENV=production
Lists one identity per role
